exercises.question: Classify the bonding in CO2 and NaCl as covalent or ionic.
exercises.question_amharic: በ CO2 እና NaCl ውስጥ ያለውን ትስስር ኮቫለንት ወይም አዮኒክ በማለት ለይተው ያስቀምጡ።
exercises.correct_answer: CO2 has covalent bonding; NaCl has ionic bonding.
exercises.correct_answer_amharic: CO2 ኮቫለንት ትስስር አለው፤ NaCl ደግሞ አዮኒክ ትስስር አለው።
exercises.step_by_step_explanation: 1. Carbon and Oxygen are non-metals, sharing electrons to form covalent bonds in CO2.\n2. Sodium is a metal and Chlorine is a non-metal, transferring electrons to form ionic bonds in NaCl.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation_amharic: 1. Carbon and Oxygen are non-metals, sharing electrons to form covalent bonds in CO2.\n2. Sodium is a metal and Chlorine is a non-metal, transferring electrons to form ionic bonds in NaCl.
exercises.formula_or_working: Non-metal + non-metal = covalent; Metal + non-metal = ionic.
